Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:13:1.hebrew: בין לרב דאמר כו' - כלומר, היכי מצינן לומר טעמא דרב משום דגמר ונתן לשום פקדון, וטעמא דשמואל משום דגמר ונתן לשום מתנה? ואי הוה דעתיה לחד מהנך, היכי הוה נחית להאי ארעא לעובדה ולאכול פירותיה? על כרחיה, סבור היה שיהא המכר קיים, ולא היה בקי בדין, וטעמא דפלוגתא דרב ושמואל טעם אחרינא הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:13:1.english: Both according to Rav, who says, etc. - That is to say, how can we say that Rav's reason is that he resolved and gave [the money] as a deposit, and Shmuel's reason is that he resolved and gave [the money] as a gift? And if his intention was for either of these, how could he enter this land to cultivate it and consume its produce? Perforce, he believed that the sale would be valid, and he was not versed in the law, and the reason for the dispute between Rav and Shmuel is a different reason.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:14:1.english: As he was doing - The robber.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:14:2.hebrew: לרב דאמר פקדון פקדון - כלומר, אליבא דרב מפרשינן דהאי מימר אמר זוזי נהוו פקדון, ולשמואל מפרשינן דהאי אמר זוזי נהוו מתנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:14:2.english: According to Rav, who says [the money is] a deposit, [it will be] a deposit - That is to say, according to Rav, we explain that this [purchaser] said: "Let the money be a deposit," and according to Shmuel, we explain that this [purchaser] said: "Let the money be a gift."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:15:1.hebrew: הלכתא - בפלוגתא קמייתא, יש לו מעות ויש לו שבח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:15:1.english: The halakha is - In the first dispute, he has [the right to recover] money and he has [the right to recover] enhancement.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:15:2.hebrew: ואע"פ דלא פירש - ולית לן דשמואל, דאמר: שבח צריך לימלך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:15:2.english: And even though he did not specify - And we do not hold in accordance with Shmuel, who said: "[For] enhancement, [the scribe] must consult [the seller]."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:16:1.english: And [omission of the] property guarantee is a scribal error - And we do not hold in accordance with [the view of] Shmuel, who said that [a property] lien requires consultation [with the seller].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:17:1.english: [If] he went back - The robber [went back] and purchased it from the original owners after he had sold [it] to the buyer.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:17:2.english: What is [the law] - [Can he] stand in the place of the owner, as if another person had purchased it, and repossess it from the buyer?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:17:3.hebrew: אמר ליה - לא מצי לאפוקה, שכשמכר, מכר לו כל זכות שתבא לידו, וכשלקחה, לא לקחה אלא כדי שתהא מקוים ביד הלוקח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:17:3.english: [Rav] said to him - [The robber] cannot repossess it [from the buyer], for when he sold [it], he sold him any right that will come into his possession, and when he purchased it, he purchased it only so that it would be established in the buyer's possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:18:1.hebrew: דלא ליקרייה גזלנא - שלא יחרפנו לוקח זה כשיוציאנה נגזל מידו ויקראנו גזלן, לכך חוזר להעמיד ממכרו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:18:1.english: That he should not call him a robber - So that this buyer will not revile him and call him a robber when the robbed party repossesses it from him; therefore, he goes back to uphold his sale.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:19:1.hebrew: דמית לוקח - לאחר שלקחה גזלן מן הבעלים, והגזלן בא להוציאה מבניו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:19:1.english: Where the purchaser died - After the robber bought it from the owner, and the robber comes to repossess it from his [the purchaser's] sons.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:19:2.english: According to the one who says - He did not go back to uphold his sale except so that the purchaser would not call him a robber.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:1:1.hebrew: המגיע לכתפים - קרוב ליקצר, אלא שעדיין צריכין לקרקע, הוי להו כפירות גמורין, ואין בעל חוב גובה אותו בלא יציאה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:1:1.english: That reaches the shoulders - [Produce that is] close to being harvested, but which still needs the ground, is considered like fully developed produce, and a creditor does not collect it without [paying for the] expenses.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:2:1.hebrew: והא מעשים בכל יום - דיני טורפי מקח באין לפני שמואל, ומגבי לבעל חוב כל השבח עם הקרקע, ואפילו מגיע לכתפים, כל זמן שצריכין לקרקע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:2:1.english: But [there are] daily incidents - Cases of [creditors] who repossess purchased property come before Shmuel, and he collects for the creditor all the enhancement along with the land, and even [enhancement that] reaches the shoulders, as long as [the crops] still need the land.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:2:2.hebrew: הא - דקתני נוטל יציאה מבעל חוב, דלא מסיק ביה בעל חוב במוכר שיעור ארעא ושבחא, הלכך יהיב בעל חוב ללוקח שבחיה ומסליק ליה. והאי דנקט למלתיה בלשון יציאה, ולא תנא נוטל כנגד החוב מבעל הקרקע והמותר מבע"ח, לאשמועינן היא גופא אתא, דהיכא דיציאה יתירה על השבח, אין לו אלא יציאה שיעור שבח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:2:2.english: That - That which is taught: "[The buyer] takes [his] expenses from the creditor," [is referring to a case] where the creditor was not owed by the seller the value of the land and the enhancement; therefore, the creditor gives the buyer his enhancement and removes him. And as for the fact that [the Tanna] formulated his statement in terms of expenses, and did not teach: "[The buyer] takes [an amount] corresponding to the debt from the owner of the land and the remainder from the creditor," it came to teach us this itself: that where the expenses exceed the enhancement, he has only expenses [up to] the amount of the enhancement.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:4:1.english: This works out well according to the one who says, etc. - This is a dispute in Ketubot (91b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:4:2.english: If the purchaser has money - To pay off the debt.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:4:3.english: He cannot dismiss the creditor - From the land, for the creditor preceded [him].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:4:4.hebrew: שפיר - דמצי למימר, דהיכא דיש קרקע מותר על החוב עם השבח, מסלק ליה ללוקח בזוזי על כרחו דלוקח, ולא מצי אמר לוקח: הב לי מן ארעא שיעור שבחי, דאמר: כוליה דידי, ואת ירדת בה שלא ברשות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:4:4.english: [This works out] well - For [one] can say that where there is land surplus to the debt with the enhancement, [the creditor] dismisses the purchaser with money against the purchaser's will, and the purchaser cannot say: "Give me from the land the amount of my enhancement," for [the creditor] says: "All of it is mine, and you entered it without permission."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:4:5.hebrew: דשוייא נהליה - לוה לבעל חוב אפותיקי להא ארעא, והכל מודים בזו, דאי הוה ליה זוזי ללוקח, לא הוה מצי מסלק ליה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:4:5.english: That he made it for him - The borrower [made] this land an *apoteiki* [designated collateral] for the creditor, and everyone agrees in this [case] that [even] if the purchaser had money, he would not be able to dismiss him [the creditor].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:5:1.english: Here we are dealing with - [This refers to] the baraita [mentioned] above.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:6:1.english: He recognized regarding it - The buyer, regarding this land.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:6:2.hebrew: שאינה שלו - של מוכר, שגזולה היתה אצלו, ולקחה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:6:2.english: That it was not his - [That it was not the property] of the seller, as it was stolen in his possession, and the buyer purchased the field.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:6:3.hebrew: מעות יש לו - מן המוכר, לכשיוציאנה נגזל מידו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:6:3.english: He has [a claim to the] money - From the seller, when the robbery victim repossesses it from his hand.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:6:4.english: He does not have [the right to] enhancement - For this land is not acquired by him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:7:1.english: He would not accept [it] - To safeguard [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 15b:9:1.english: The money is returned - The betrothal money is returned to him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:17:1.hebrew: חזר ולקחה כו' - בלא הכיר בה מיירי, וקמיבעיא ליה אם הגזלן יכול לבטל המקח ולהחזיר לו מעותיו, או לאו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:17:1.english: [If] he then purchased it, etc. - [The Gemara] is dealing with [a case where the buyer] did not know [that the field was not the seller's], and he [Shmuel] is asking whether the robber can void the sale and return his money to him, or not.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:19:1.hebrew: דמית לוקח - פרש"י: אחר שלקחה. ואין נראה, דמיד שקנה הגזלן, זכה בו לוקח; ואטו משום דמית ליה בתר הכי פקע כחו? אלא יש לומר, דמית קודם שלקחה הגזלן מנגזל. (ומית גזלן), צ"ל שהיה חולה או גוסס בשעה שלקחה מנגזל:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:19:1.english: Where the purchaser died - Rashi explained: After [the robber] purchased it [from the owner]. But this does not seem [correct], for as soon as the robber acquired [it], the purchaser acquired title to it; and is it just because he died afterward that his right is extinguished? Rather, one must say that [the purchaser] died before the robber purchased it from the robbery victim. (And regarding "where the robber died"), it must be said that he was ill or moribund at the time he purchased it from the robbery victim.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:3:1.hebrew: הא דלא מסיק אלא שיעור ארעא תימה כיון דלא מסיק אלא - שיעור ארעא, אמאי נוטל שבח היתר על היציאה? וי"ל, דבלאו הכי פריך שפיר הניחא כו'. ולפי המסקנא דמוקי באפותיקי, א"ש: דאע"פ דלא מסיק ביה אלא שיעור ארעא, נותן לו היציאה ללוקח, והשבח היתר על היציאה לוקח חנם, כדין יורד לתוך שדה חבירו שלא ברשות:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:3:1.english: That [the creditor] was owed only the value of the land - It is astonishing: Since he was owed only the value of the land, why does [the creditor] take the enhancement that exceeds the expenses? And one can say that even without this, [the Gemara] rightly asks: "This works out well, etc." And according to the conclusion, which establishes [the case] as an apoteiki, it works out well: for even though he was owed by him only the value of the land, he gives the expenses to the purchaser, and the enhancement that exceeds the expenses [the creditor] takes for free, in accordance with the law of one who enters another's field without permission.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:4:1.english: This works out well according to the one who says, etc. - [This is] explained in [the chapter] HaMekabbel (below, Bava Metzia 110b). (And see Ketubot 91b, s.v. Mai).

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:5:1.hebrew: כגון דשוייא אפותיקי - השתא מצי איירי דמסיק ביה אפי' שיעור ארעא ושבחא, ואפ"ה, כיון דשוייא אפותיקי, צריך ליתן היציאה כדין יורד כו', כדאמרי' בפרק המקבל (שם.) גבי יתומים אומרים אנו השבחנו ורוצים היציא', דמיירי באפותיקי, ואע"ג דמסיק בהו שיעור ארעא ושבחא, דהא אם אביהם השביח גובה הכל. ומיהו אין ראיה, דשאני יתומים, שאין להם על מי לחזור ליקח היציאה; דכיון שעשה אביהם אפותיקי, הרי הוא כיורד לתוך שדה חבירו שלא ברשות, שאינו מפסיד היציאה. אבל בלוקח, שאינו מפסיד כלום, שהמוכר משלם לו היציאה והשבח, שזה פוטרו מחובו – מצינו למימר דאפילו באפותיקי, כיון דמסיק ביה שיעור ארעא ושבחא, שקיל הכל, שבשביל שעשאה אפותיקי לא יגרע כחו. וא"ת: כיון דאמר ליה לא יהא לך פרעון אלא מזו, כשמוכר לאחר הוה ליה כלוקח מגזלן, שהרי אינו של מוכר – א"כ, למה נוטל מן המוכר השבח היתר על היציאה? והא לוקח מגזלן לשמואל לית ליה שבחא! וי"ל: כגון שמכרה קודם שבא זמנו של בעל חוב, דחל המקח עד הזמן, ולא דמי לגזלן שלא חל המקח כלל, דזוזי הוו הלואה, ואם ישלם שבח הוה ליה רבית; ואפילו מכרה אחר הזמן, היה סבור לפייס בע"ח בזוזי, וחל המקח עד שטרפה ממנו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:5:1.english: For example, where he made it an apoteiki - Now [that the Gemara establishes this,] it could be dealing [even] where he [the creditor] is owed even the amount of the land and the enhancement; and even so, since he made it an apoteiki, he must give [the purchaser] the expenses, in accordance with the law of one who descends [into another's field without permission], etc., as we say in chapter HaMekabel (ibid. [110b]) regarding [the case where] orphans say, "We enhanced [the field]," and want the expenses, which deals with an apoteiki; and [this is] even though he is owed by them the amount of the land and the enhancement, for if their father had enhanced [it], he would collect everything. However, there is no proof [from there], for orphans are different, as they have no one to turn back to in order to collect the expenses; for since their father made it an apoteiki, [an orphan] is like one who descends into another's field without permission, who does not lose [his right to] the expenses. But in the case of a purchaser, who loses nothing, because the seller pays him the expenses and the enhancement—since this discharges him [the seller] from his debt [to the creditor]—we can say that even with an apoteiki, since he [the creditor] is owed the amount of the land and the enhancement, he takes everything; for on account of having made it an apoteiki, his power should not be diminished. And if you say: Since he said to him, "You shall have repayment only from this [field]," when he sells it to another person, [the purchaser] should be considered like one who purchases from a robber, since [the land] does not belong to the seller; if so, why does he collect from the seller the enhancement that exceeds the expenses? For one who purchases from a robber, according to Shmuel, has no [claim to] enhancement! And one can answer: [This can be explained,] for example, where he sold it before the creditor's due date arrived, so the purchase took effect until that time; and it is not comparable to a robber, where the purchase did not take effect at all, so that the money was [deemed] a loan, and if he were to pay for the enhancement it would be usury. And even if he sold it after the due date, he [the seller] believed that he would appease the creditor with money, and the purchase took effect until [the creditor] repossessed it from him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:6:1.hebrew: מעות יש לו שבח אין לו - תימה: בהגוזל קמא (ב"ק דף צה. ושם: ד"ה דלמא) תנא: ה' גובין מן המחוררין שבח, ומוקי לה בת"ח דידע דקרקע אינה נגזלת; אלמא אפילו בהכיר בה יש לו שבח! וי"ל, דהתם מיירי כשקיבל עליו אחריות:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:6:1.english: He has [a claim to] money, [but] he does not have [the right to] enhancement - It is astonishing: for in [the chapter] HaGozel Kama (Bava Kamma 95a, and ibid., s.v. Dilma), [a baraita] taught: Five [claimants] collect enhancement from unencumbered property, and [the Gemara] establishes it as referring to a Torah scholar who knew that land cannot be stolen; evidently, even when he recognized that it was not his, he has [the right to] enhancement! And one can say that there it is dealing with [a case where the seller] accepted guarantee upon himself.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:8:1.hebrew: ונתן לו לשם מתנה - אבל בערכין, פרק המוכר שדה (דף כט: ושם), גבי המוכר שדהו בשנת היובל עצמה, דאמר שמואל מעות חוזרין – ליכא למימר: אדם יודע שאין מכר ביובל; דאין זה פשוט, דהא אמר רב: מכורה ויוצאה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 15b:8:1.english: And he gave it to him as a gift - However, in Arakhin, in the chapter HaMokher Sadeh (29b, and ibid.), regarding one who sells his field during the Jubilee Year itself, where Shmuel says that the money is returned, one cannot say [that] a person knows that there is no sale during the Jubilee [and resolved to give the money as a gift], for this is not obvious, for behold, Rav says: "[It is] sold and goes out."
